search_assistance: The search programs were written and run with Claude Code (Anthropic) under the direction of the repository author.
published_edge_format: n m header, then sorted undirected edges u v
graph_relation_to_discovery: The published labelling is the Z9 voltage-graph labelling 9u + x of the quotient by the freely acting normal subgroup C9 of the automorphism group. It is isomorphic to the discovered orbit graph; orbit_graph_certificate.json gives the isomorphism, checked by check_isomorphism.py (and by nauty canonical forms).
